headline: A number of documents signed between Uzbekistan and Oman
summary: Uzbekistan and Oman exchanged documents following talks between President Shavkat Mirziyoyev and Sultan Haitham bin Tariq Al Said. The papers include a strategic partnership agreement and a bilateral business council accord.
why: Bilateral business councils and partnership agreements help frame trade, investment and project cooperation between governments and their private sectors. Oman is a Gulf state with significant energy and investment links.
original_headline: O‘zbekiston va O‘mon o‘rtasida bir qator hujjatlar imzolandi
